name: 18103 · Allentown, PA
findings: ZIP 18103 (Allentown) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18103 (Allentown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18103 (Allentown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 84 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
